description: Norwegian salmon feed composition time series 2010-2025 — percentage of feed raw materials by type, total volume, and domestic vs. imported share
methodology: Key years (2010, 2012, 2016, 2020) from Nofima/FHF resource accounts. Intermediate years interpolated. Post-2020 qualitative estimates. All values as % of total feed raw materials (dry matter basis) unless noted.
primary_sources: Nofima/FHF prosjekt 901604: Ressursregnskap for forravarer til laks og regnbueorret
Framtiden i vare hender: Soya i norsk for (2021)

market_structure.note: 88% market share since at least 2005 (Intrafish). Mowi Feed is a smaller vertically integrated producer.

timeseries.note: Nofima/FHF resource account exists for 2010 but exact values require PDF extraction
